question: Label-free per-channel signal quality and between-participant stability in the frozen QC-accepted cohort

metric_definitions.mean: arithmetic mean in stored raw amplitude units
metric_definitions.mad: median absolute deviation from temporal median, unscaled
metric_definitions.artifact_violations: strict exceedance of existing sidecar amplitude/flatness limits; undefined when no limit configured
metric_definitions.anomaly_rates: fraction among windows with defined leave-one-out score; undefined counts also saved

relative_score: leave-one-channel-out (value - median of other 13 finite values) / unscaled MAD of other channels; at least 7 finite peers; MAD=0 gives undefined score
participant_elevated_definition: record-balanced subject anomaly rate strictly above that subject's median rate across 14 channels; not a bad-channel threshold
aggregation: window medians and anomaly means per record; equal-record means per participant; equal-participant median/IQR globally and within folds; window-pooled statistics separately labelled
spectral: existing Welch nperseg=256 Hann detrend=constant; total PSD integral 0..128 Hz; relative bands use sum of existing delta/theta/alpha/beta/gamma powers 1..45 Hz; high-frequency ratio=gamma 30..45 / sum bands
line_frequency_ratio: omitted: no confirmed acquisition mains-frequency contract
nonfinite_policy: finite fraction per channel; all other metrics for any nonfinite channel undefined, no interpolation; canonical raw loader fails on any nonfinite window
zero_rms_policy: roughness ratio and zero-power spectral ratios undefined
